notes.prices: USD. Date, distribution-and-split-adjusted close, split-adjusted close, volume. Index observations are index points.
notes.financials: First original annual 10-K, available only after filed. US-GAAP USD, diluted EPS USD/share, diluted weighted-average shares in units. Unavailable tags remain null. No quarterly interpolation.
notes.estimates: USD/share. Current fiscal year GAAP consensus versus the same fiscal year's estimate 30 days earlier, observed on capture date. A single observation is not a historical forecast archive.
notes.macro: FRED DGS10/DGS2 percentages and CBOE VIXCLS index points. Observation dates, latest vintage. Descriptive use only.
notes.universes: S&P and Nasdaq lists are current observed constituents with survivor bias when applied to the past. Historical research must use an independently dated frozen or point-in-time cohort.
